repo.name: ROS Pocket — upstream
repo.description: Independent upstream F-Droid repository for ROS Pocket. Not the official f-droid.org catalogue. Direct DDS ROS 2 inspector, read-only. APKs signed by the ROS Pocket upstream production key.

apps.description:
ROS Pocket is a read-only Android inspector using direct DDS and Cyclone DDS.
Inspect discovered topics, supported telemetry types and sensor views, monitor
numeric histories and export CSV, and manage portable local bench profiles.

ARM64 devices, Android 9 (API 28) or later. Network discovery depends on your
ROS domain, peers and network setup. RF/IP recovery is not qualified; a node
topology diagram is deferred to v2.

This is the independent upstream repository, not the official f-droid.org
catalogue. APKs keep the upstream production signature used by GitHub releases.
apps.summary: Read-only ROS 2 and DDS inspection on Android

en-US.description:
ROS Pocket is a read-only ROS 2/DDS inspector for Android phones and tablets.

Connect on the same IPv4 Wi-Fi/LAN, select the ROS domain and the manual Humble or Jazzy graph format, then inspect:
• Topic types, publishers, subscribers, endpoint QoS and announced ROS nodes.
• Up to four live topic watches with counters, received rate and data age.
• Numeric plots with pause and CSV export of retained real samples.
• A dedicated rosout console and structured standard messages.
• Bounded LaserScan and Image/CompressedImage views.
• Saved connection/watch/plot/sensor profiles with JSON import/export.

The application speaks DDS directly; it does not require rosbridge or a cloud account. It sends no robot commands, parameter writes, service requests or teleoperation commands. Internet permission is needed for local network sockets; there are no ads or analytics.

Limitations: ARM64, Android 9 or newer, same-subnet IPv4 networking and a defined set of standard message types. Graph format selection is manual; mixed distributions and all RMW/network/device combinations are not guaranteed. The node/topic diagram is deferred to v2. Physical Wi-Fi/IP disruption/recovery remains unqualified. Numeric retention is bounded and is not a lossless recorder or rosbag replacement.

This is a bench engineering tool, not a safety instrument. The production package installs separately from ROS Pocket DEV; their signatures and private data are not interchangeable.
en-US.name: ROS Pocket
en-US.summary: Inspect ROS 2 topics, telemetry, plots and logs directly over DDS
en-US.whatsNew: First stable-version packaging of the read-only bench inspector: original adaptive/themed icon, Apache-2.0 licensing, separate production and DEV identities, and source-only native build metadata for F-Droid. Preserves the v0.9 functionality; no topology diagram is added.

pt-BR.description:
ROS Pocket é um inspetor ROS 2/DDS somente leitura para celulares e tablets Android.

Conecte na mesma rede IPv4 Wi-Fi/LAN, selecione o domínio ROS e o formato manual de grafo Humble ou Jazzy. Inspecione tópicos, tipos, publicadores/assinantes, QoS e nós anunciados; acompanhe quatro watches, gráficos numéricos com pausa e CSV, rosout, mensagens estruturadas e visualizações limitadas de LaserScan ou Image/CompressedImage. Salve e transporte configurações por perfis JSON.

DDS direto, sem rosbridge, conta na nuvem, anúncios ou analytics. A permissão de Internet permite sockets de rede local. O app não envia comandos ao robô nem escreve parâmetros ou invoca serviços/teleop.

Limites: ARM64, Android 9+, IPv4 na mesma sub-rede e tipos padrão definidos. Formato do grafo é manual; não há garantia de todas as combinações ROS/RMW/rede/dispositivo. Diagrama nó→tópico→nó fica para a v2. Interrupção e recuperação física de Wi-Fi/IP continuam não qualificadas. Retenção numérica é limitada, não gravação sem perdas nem rosbag.

Ferramenta de bancada, não instrumento de segurança. O pacote de produção instala ao lado do ROS Pocket DEV, sem compartilhar assinatura ou dados privados.
pt-BR.name: ROS Pocket
pt-BR.summary: Inspecione tópicos ROS 2, telemetria, gráficos e logs diretamente por DDS
pt-BR.whatsNew: Empacotamento da primeira versão estável do inspetor somente leitura: ícone original adaptativo/monocromático, Apache-2.0, identidades produção/DEV separadas e receita nativa inteiramente de fonte para F-Droid. Preserva as funções da v0.9; sem diagrama de topologia nesta versão.
